method: Bounded 2 phases, 11 jobs, 3 loadouts x2 manual profiles plus4 specified combos. Two screen seeds and six independent holdouts. Same actual paid budgets/stats/gear per matched before-after pair, not equal prices across different builds. Frozen pre-patch content executes current engine legacy path; this is a counterfactual data comparison, not a historical binary benchmark. Support assessed by healing/team contribution, never solo DPS. No exhaustive search or global calibration.
